annotations.title: ARR bridge: new, expansion, contraction, churn

description: Explain how ARR moved over a period: ending ARR = starting ARR + new + expansion - contraction - churned. Returns net new ARR, growth, the SaaS quick ratio ((new + expansion) / (contraction + churned)), and net and gross revenue retention of the starting base. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/arr-calculator

churned_arr.description: ARR lost to customers who cancelled

contraction_arr.description: ARR lost to downgrades from customers who stayed

expansion_arr.description: ARR added by existing customers (upgrades, seats, add-ons)

new_arr.description: ARR from customers who started paying in the period

start_arr.description: ARR at the start of the period
